look: Sathya's B&W collage reel series (copied from their reference video): white paper texture wall with grey vignette and drifting window / spotlight / soft light; their halftone sticker cut-outs pinned with soft drop shadows; AI for Real Life brand accents: pink #FB3779 and blue #3C46FD (their logo); pro camera rig with parallax back plane, handheld drift, dutch tilts, snap punch-ins, whip-ins/outs, match-cut zooms and roll transitions; AI for Real Life logo end card; camera travels through a tall world (pushes, tilts, whips with motion blur), Morven kicker over a huge Allenoire headline with random-letter reveals, Regarn Black tapes and stamps, hand-drawn pink marks, torn-paper B&W stock clips, glitch blocks at cuts. Fonts are Sathya's files: Allenoire-400, Morven-400, Regarn 100/400/700/900. Instagram Reel 9:16, every beat timed to Sathya's voice-over (Reel_05 voice-over, 79.9 s), text kept inside the Reels safe zone. Logo slots: plain cream cards that hold perfectly still in the foreground, for Sathya to lay official logos over in their editor.

scenes.name: Harvard warning
scenes.desc: Photo and HBS logo slots over a campus sticker with a slow pink warning pulse; Karim R. Lakhani; AI warning; the group most at risk isn't who you think.

scenes.name: Three ways
scenes.desc: Three numbered panels pop in: cyborgs, centaurs, self-automators; a still photo slot sits in the top corner.

scenes.name: Cyborgs
scenes.desc: The half-human, half-robot head with arrows running both ways: solve problems side by side with AI, in real time.

scenes.name: Centaurs
scenes.desc: A centaur split down a dashed line: the human half and the AI half divide tasks cleanly.

scenes.name: Self-automators
scenes.desc: A slumped worker presses play, the switch flips off and the brain goes dark: accept all.

scenes.name: Failure
scenes.desc: An unplugged cord swings down: self-automation leads straight to failure.

scenes.name: Meat interface
scenes.desc: Meat interface: a puppet-strung worker ferries Ctrl C from the robot and Ctrl V to the keyboard; value counts from 100% to 0%.

scenes.name: Performance gap
scenes.desc: A line splits into a K inside organisations; the top branch climbs to the top AI power users at peak productivity.

scenes.name: Left behind
scenes.desc: The manager who resists adapting sinks while an adaptable hands-on worker leapfrogs past him.

scenes.name: Expertise to $0
scenes.desc: A price tag counts from $$$ to $0: the cost of basic expertise drops to zero, and AI output defaults to average.

scenes.name: Your real moat
scenes.desc: Basic execution is struck out; personal taste, rigorous skepticism and the fundamentals land one by one.

scenes.name: Which are you?
scenes.desc: Cyborg? Centaur? Meat interface? Drop it in the comments, with a hand pointing down.

scenes.name: AI for Real Life
scenes.desc: End card: the AI for Real Life logo pops onto the brand blue.
